name: bash-guard
description: A seatbelt for YOLO mode: blocks catastrophic shell commands (rm -rf ~, mkfs, dd to a disk, fork bombs) and asks before risky ones (force-push, reset --hard, DROP TABLE, curl | sh), even with permissions bypassed.

risky.title: Risky commands
risky.description: What to do with risky (not catastrophic) commands: confirm asks you, block refuses, allow lets them run.

customBlock.title: Extra block pattern
customBlock.description: A case-insensitive regular expression; matching commands are always blocked. Empty: none.

customConfirm.title: Extra confirm pattern
customConfirm.description: A case-insensitive regular expression; matching commands ask first. Empty: none.
